 Pregnant! Zazie Beetz Debuts Baby Bump at ’Nocturne’ Premiere
 Facebook 
 Twitter 
 Getty Images 
 Actress Zazie Beetz, 35, is pregnant with her first child!
 On Tuesday night, Beetz announced her pregnancy by baring her growing baby bump at the NYC premiere of her new series “Nocturne.”
 Beetz hit the red carpet with screenwriter husband David Rysdahl, who cradled her baby bump.
 Getty Images 
 The couple got married in 2023 after nine years together.
